feature: Per-turn changed-file tree and scoped change actions

contracts: Bounded 200-entry summary cache and in-flight deduplication
Settled assistant turn exposes changed files
Folders initially expanded, collapse/expand all, per-folder and overall line totals
File click opens CURRENT workspace diff summary, matches path or oldPath, opens staged/unstaged diff, falls back to ordinary file; deleted file leaves diff sidebar visible
Header diff action opens current changed-files sidebar
Folders before files, locale-aware names, descendant totals
Mount-relative display with mount identity retained in folder keys
Net first selected preimage to last selected postimage per path
Selection excludes operations outside selected tool calls
External/binary/large files use created/deleted/modified rather than invented line counts
Complete line comparison using diffLines with oneChangePerToken

native.identity: Unique host invocation token and durable mutation nonce; model toolCallId remains provenance only and may repeat. Fixed-agent journal query and exact projected turn membership are rechecked for actions.
native.summary: SQLite read transaction loads first-before/last-after selected snapshots, verifies SHA-256, counts complete lines including final-newline and BOM identity, includes every net path within explicit bounds. No current working-file reads.
native.display: Adjacent assistant rounds form one settled-turn tree. Folder expansion survives same-chat updates and chat switches. Ordinary text messages allocate no hidden tree. A 200-entry per-view cache and stale request epochs protect asynchronous responses.
native.defaultActions: Current Git diff/sidebar behavior follows pinned source; saved diff and undo review are explicitly named optional actions.
native.savedActions: Saved diff uses independently revalidated journal endpoints. Review turn for undo populates existing conflict-checked mutation panel with exact selected records and original absolute paths, including changes older than the ordinary 200-row history window.
native.binaryAndLarge: Explicit created/deleted/modified badges and unavailable-count text. Bounded text preview refusal never substitutes current files for missing or oversized snapshots.
native.rename: Moves retain both removed and created paths, matching the pinned per-path ToolCallFileEdit summary shape. The current Git opener separately handles oldPath rename matching.
native.durability: Journal schema stores an optional host invocation UUID independently of raw model tool IDs. Engine persists exact assistant-batch bindings before dispatch and reconciles fixed-agent terminal records after restart. Sandbox inner writes attach to their original outer request without claiming the script completed.
native.sideChatOwnership: Current Git sidebar/default file actions pass the originating main or side-chat owner and revalidate it. A different-workspace child does not rebind its parent; actual host regression passed in the shared run.

initialHost.failure: Saved-diff test searched CodeEditor; actual FileDiffView uses QPlainTextEdit fileDiffText. Lookup corrected, exact-content assertions retained; rerun pending.
initialHost.note: Historical initial run; corrected fixture searches the actual FileDiffView QPlainTextEdit while retaining before/saved/outside assertions.

committedCancellation.scope: Actual AgentEngine + AgentToolHost + native QuickJS worker with loopback model fixtures; direct commit/cancel, reused model ID, owner destruction/restart, rejected durable dispatch, sandbox committed inner write with missing outer result, and direct/sandbox rejection observers starting replacement requests.

visual.kind: Actual Qt offscreen component renders; no pixel-exact upstream parity claim
visual.observed: Initial light render exposed transparent palette inference; opaque host palette resolution and dynamic light/dark/light regression now pass.

sharedHost.scope: Actual hidden MainWindow: direct and sandbox interrupted dispatch restart hydration/persistence, current Git row/header routing, explicit immutable saved preview, stale/foreign callbacks, selected mutations older than 200 rows, original-workspace dirty editor undo refusal, missing-ID coverage, and different-workspace side-chat ownership without rebinding parent.

remaining: Broader final aggregate suite is pending; focused shared components, actual host and new rejection observer-race regression passed.
Current Git default actions support the chat connected workspace (ws1). Other mounts retain explicitly named saved preview and original-path undo review rather than inventing current Git ownership.
Historical records without a verifiable saved journal are explicitly unavailable; raw repeated model tool IDs are never used to guess ownership.
Explicit bounds can make totals or text previews unavailable; these are reported, not silently truncated into exact totals.
The saved preview renderer has its own 1200-line display cap; full summary totals come from complete verified endpoints within summary bounds.
This slice does not establish full Stagewise feature or screenshot parity.
evidenceSanitization: Canonical LF; XML machine hostname replaced with redacted. Temporary test/source path references retained; no user credentials, real profiles or remote responses are included.
